simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דַּכָּא (H1793) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דַּכָּא (dakkâʼ) means crushed (literally powder, or figuratively, contrite) First listed occurrence: Isa 57 15.

definitions.full: H1793. dakka ' I. דַּכָּא adjective contrite (crushed) — דַּכָּא Isa 57:15 ; דַּכְּאֵי Psa 34:19 — contrite Isa 57:15 (|| שְׁפַלרֿוּחַ ); ׳ד רוּחַ Psa 34:19 (|| נִשְׁבְּרֵילֵֿב ). II. דַּכָּא noun [masculine] dust (as pulverized), עַדדַּֿכָּא אֱנוֺשׁ תָּשֵׁב Psa 90:3 (on form compare Ba NB 143 ).
